title: Accounting is downstream evidence: one VMM book, many reporting views
summary: VMM has one durable statutory book and uses Accounting Core events/policies/journals as downstream accounting truth. Reporting boundaries project immutable journals; they do not create desk companies, duplicate ledgers or operational truth.
invariants: Statutory identity is VECTOR_MERIDIAN_MARKETS_LTD / VMM-STAT / ENTITY_GAAP.
Current VMM accounting protocols are vmm.accounting/0.11, vmm.accounting.persistence/0.11 and vmm.accounting.reporting/0.11.
VMM accounting policy code compiles with 50-digit precision.
AccountingFileStore recovery preserves journal/source/policy and period evidence, but does not reconstruct trading, synthetic or Queue Fabric state.
Federation may appear as lender/counterparty dimension but never as VMM reporting entity or book authority.
CVA/FVA and collateral haircuts remain accounting/risk evidence and cannot rewrite contractual payoff truth.

provenance.claim: One-way accounting authority, one-book reporting, replay, close-out/netting mappings, precision and durable store.
